import Mathlib

inductive Node where
  | nil
  | node (val : Nat) (left : Node) (right : Node)
deriving Inhabited, Repr

open Node

def view (t : Node) : Set Nat :=
  match t with
  | nil => ∅
  | node v l r => {v} ∪ view l ∪ view r

def tree_contains (t : Node) (target : Nat) : Bool :=
  match t with
  | nil => false
  | node v l r => v == target || tree_contains l target || tree_contains r target

def tree_distinct (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | nil => True
  | node v l r =>
      tree_distinct l ∧ tree_distinct r ∧
      v ∉ view l ∧ v ∉ view r ∧
      (view l ∩ view r = ∅)

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def lowest_common_ancestor_precond (root : Node) (p q : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  tree_contains root p ∧ tree_contains root q ∧ tree_distinct root
  -- !benchmark @end precond

def aux (root : Node) (p q : Nat) : Option Nat × Bool × Bool :=
  match root with
  | nil => (none, false, false)
  | node val l r =>
      let (lcaL, hasPL, hasQL) := aux l p q
      let (lcaR, hasPR, hasQR) := aux r p q
      let hasP := (val == p) || hasPL || hasPR
      let hasQ := (val == q) || hasQL || hasQR
      let lca :=
        if lcaL.isSome then lcaL
        else if lcaR.isSome then lcaR
        else if hasP && hasQ then some val else none
      (lca, hasP, hasQ)

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def lowest_common_ancestor (root : Node) (p q : Nat)
    (h_precond : lowest_common_ancestor_precond root p q) : Option Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  (aux root p q).1
  -- !benchmark @end code

def is_ancestor (root : Node) (anc target : Nat) : Prop :=
  match root with
  | nil => False
  | node v l r =>
      if v = anc then tree_contains (node v l r) target = true
      else is_ancestor l anc target ∨ is_ancestor r anc target

-- ADDED: Helper to determine depth for the "Lowest" check
def get_depth (root : Node) (target : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  match root with
  | nil => none
  | node v l r =>
      if v == target then some 0
      else
        match get_depth l target, get_depth r target with
        | some d, _ => some (d + 1)
        | none, some d => some (d + 1)
        | none, none => none

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def lowest_common_ancestor_postcond (root : Node) (p q : Nat) (result : Option Nat)
    (_ : lowest_common_ancestor_precond root p q) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some lca =>
      -- 1. Validity: It is a common ancestor
      is_ancestor root lca p ∧
      is_ancestor root lca q ∧
      -- 2. Optimality: It is the LOWEST (Deepest) common ancestor
      (∀ x, is_ancestor root x p → is_ancestor root x q →
         match get_depth root x, get_depth root lca with
         | some dx, some dres => dx ≤ dres
         | _, _ => True) -- Should imply dx and dres exist if is_ancestor is true
  | none => False
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

theorem contains_iff_view (t : Node) (x : Nat) : tree_contains t x = true ↔ x ∈ view t := by
  induction t with
  | nil => simp [tree_contains, view]
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
      simp only [tree_contains, view, Bool.or_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, ihl, ihr,
        Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      constructor
      · rintro ((h | h) | h)
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inl h.symm)
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inr h)
        · exact Or.inr h
      · rintro ((h | h) | h)
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inl h.symm)
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inr h)
        · exact Or.inr h

theorem disj_contra {l r : Node} {x : Nat} (h : view l ∩ view r = ∅)
    (h1 : tree_contains l x = true) (h2 : tree_contains r x = true) : False := by
  have hx := Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem.mp h x
  exact hx ⟨(contains_iff_view l x).mp h1, (contains_iff_view r x).mp h2⟩

theorem anc_contains_anc : ∀ (t : Node) (x tgt : Nat), is_ancestor t x tgt →
    tree_contains t x = true := by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | nil => intro x tgt h; simp [is_ancestor] at h
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
      intro x tgt h
      rw [is_ancestor] at h
      split at h
      · next hv => simp [tree_contains, hv]
      · rcases h with h | h
        · simp [tree_contains, ihl x tgt h]
        · simp [tree_contains, ihr x tgt h]

theorem anc_contains_tgt : ∀ (t : Node) (x tgt : Nat), is_ancestor t x tgt →
    tree_contains t tgt = true := by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | nil => intro x tgt h; simp [is_ancestor] at h
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
      intro x tgt h
      rw [is_ancestor] at h
      split at h
      · exact h
      · rcases h with h | h
        · simp [tree_contains, ihl x tgt h]
        · simp [tree_contains, ihr x tgt h]

theorem anc_left (v : Nat) (l r : Node) (x tgt : Nat) (h : is_ancestor l x tgt) :
    is_ancestor (node v l r) x tgt := by
  rw [is_ancestor]
  split
  · simp [tree_contains, anc_contains_tgt l x tgt h]
  · exact Or.inl h

theorem anc_right (v : Nat) (l r : Node) (x tgt : Nat) (h : is_ancestor r x tgt) :
    is_ancestor (node v l r) x tgt := by
  rw [is_ancestor]
  split
  · simp [tree_contains, anc_contains_tgt r x tgt h]
  · exact Or.inr h

theorem anc_self (v : Nat) (l r : Node) (tgt : Nat)
    (h : tree_contains (node v l r) tgt = true) : is_ancestor (node v l r) v tgt := by
  rw [is_ancestor]
  simp [h]

theorem depth_isSome (t : Node) (x : Nat) :
    (get_depth t x).isSome = true ↔ tree_contains t x = true := by
  induction t with
  | nil => simp [get_depth, tree_contains]
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
      rw [get_depth, tree_contains]
      by_cases hv : v = x
      · simp [hv]
      · cases hl : get_depth l x <;> cases hr : get_depth r x <;>
          simp_all

theorem depth_none_of (t : Node) (x : Nat) (h : ¬ tree_contains t x = true) :
    get_depth t x = none := by
  cases hg : get_depth t x with
  | none => rfl
  | some d => exact absurd ((depth_isSome t x).mp (by rw [hg]; rfl)) h

theorem depth_some_of (t : Node) (x : Nat) (h : tree_contains t x = true) :
    ∃ d, get_depth t x = some d := by
  cases hg : get_depth t x with
  | none =>
      have := (depth_isSome t x).mpr h
      rw [hg] at this
      simp at this
  | some d => exact ⟨d, rfl⟩

theorem depth_self (v : Nat) (l r : Node) : get_depth (node v l r) v = some 0 := by
  rw [get_depth]; simp

theorem depth_node_left (v : Nat) (l r : Node) (x d : Nat) (hv : ¬ v = x)
    (hl : get_depth l x = some d) : get_depth (node v l r) x = some (d + 1) := by
  rw [get_depth]
  simp [hv, hl]

theorem depth_node_right (v : Nat) (l r : Node) (x d : Nat) (hv : ¬ v = x)
    (hl : get_depth l x = none) (hr : get_depth r x = some d) :
    get_depth (node v l r) x = some (d + 1) := by
  rw [get_depth]
  simp [hv, hl, hr]

theorem aux_node_eq (v : Nat) (l r : Node) (p q : Nat) :
    aux (node v l r) p q =
      ((if (aux l p q).1.isSome then (aux l p q).1
        else if (aux r p q).1.isSome then (aux r p q).1
        else if ((v == p) || (aux l p q).2.1 || (aux r p q).2.1) &&
                ((v == q) || (aux l p q).2.2 || (aux r p q).2.2) then some v else none),
       ((v == p) || (aux l p q).2.1 || (aux r p q).2.1),
       ((v == q) || (aux l p q).2.2 || (aux r p q).2.2)) := by
  rw [aux]

theorem aux_hasP (p q : Nat) (t : Node) : (aux t p q).2.1 = tree_contains t p := by
  induction t with
  | nil => rfl
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
      rw [aux_node_eq]
      simp only [tree_contains, ihl, ihr]

theorem aux_hasQ (p q : Nat) (t : Node) : (aux t p q).2.2 = tree_contains t q := by
  induction t with
  | nil => rfl
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
      rw [aux_node_eq]
      simp only [tree_contains, ihl, ihr]

theorem aux_some (p q : Nat) (t : Node) : (aux t p q).1.isSome = true →
    tree_contains t p = true ∧ tree_contains t q = true := by
  induction t with
  | nil => intro h; simp [aux] at h
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
      intro h
      rw [aux_node_eq] at h
      simp only at h
      split at h
      · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ihl h
        exact ⟨by simp [tree_contains, h1], by simp [tree_contains, h2]⟩
      · split at h
        · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ihr h
          exact ⟨by simp [tree_contains, h1], by simp [tree_contains, h2]⟩
        · split at h
          · rename_i hcond
            rw [Bool.and_eq_true] at hcond
            obtain ⟨hc1, hc2⟩ := hcond
            rw [aux_hasP, aux_hasP] at hc1
            rw [aux_hasQ, aux_hasQ] at hc2
            exact ⟨by rw [tree_contains]; exact hc1, by rw [tree_contains]; exact hc2⟩
          · simp at h

theorem aux_main (p q : Nat) (t : Node) : tree_distinct t → tree_contains t p = true →
    tree_contains t q = true →
    ∃ m, (aux t p q).1 = some m ∧ is_ancestor t m p ∧ is_ancestor t m q ∧
      ∀ x dx dm, is_ancestor t x p → is_ancestor t x q →
        get_depth t x = some dx → get_depth t m = some dm → dx ≤ dm := by
  induction t with
  | nil => intro _ h _; simp [tree_contains] at h
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
      intro hd hp hq
      rw [tree_distinct] at hd
      obtain ⟨hdl, hdr, hvl, hvr, hlr⟩ := hd
      by_cases h1 : tree_contains l p = true ∧ tree_contains l q = true
      · obtain ⟨hlp, hlq⟩ := h1
        obtain ⟨m, hm, hmp, hmq, hopt⟩ := ihl hdl hlp hlq
        have hrp : ¬ tree_contains r p = true := fun h => disj_contra hlr hlp h
        have hrq : ¬ tree_contains r q = true := fun h => disj_contra hlr hlq h
        refine ⟨m, ?_, anc_left v l r m p hmp, anc_left v l r m q hmq, ?_⟩
        · rw [aux_node_eq]; simp [hm]
        · intro x dx dm hxp hxq hdx hdm
          by_cases hxv : v = x
          · rw [← hxv] at hdx
            rw [depth_self] at hdx
            simp at hdx
            omega
          · rw [is_ancestor, if_neg hxv] at hxp hxq
            have hxpl : is_ancestor l x p := by
              rcases hxp with h | h
              · exact h
              · exact absurd (anc_contains_tgt r x p h) hrp
            have hxql : is_ancestor l x q := by
              rcases hxq with h | h
              · exact h
              · exact absurd (anc_contains_tgt r x q h) hrq
            obtain ⟨d', hd'⟩ := depth_some_of l x (anc_contains_anc l x p hxpl)
            obtain ⟨e', he'⟩ := depth_some_of l m (anc_contains_anc l m p hmp)
            rw [depth_node_left v l r x d' hxv hd'] at hdx
            have hmv : ¬ v = m := by
              intro hc
              subst hc
              exact hvl ((contains_iff_view l v).mp (anc_contains_anc l v p hmp))
            rw [depth_node_left v l r m e' hmv he'] at hdm
            simp at hdx hdm
            have := hopt x d' e' hxpl hxql hd' he'
            omega
      · by_cases h2 : tree_contains r p = true ∧ tree_contains r q = true
        · obtain ⟨hrp, hrq⟩ := h2
          obtain ⟨m, hm, hmp, hmq, hopt⟩ := ihr hdr hrp hrq
          have hlp : ¬ tree_contains l p = true := fun h => disj_contra hlr h hrp
          have hlq : ¬ tree_contains l q = true := fun h => disj_contra hlr h hrq
          have hA : (aux l p q).1 = none := by
            cases hg : (aux l p q).1 with
            | none => rfl
            | some m' => exact absurd (aux_some p q l (by rw [hg]; rfl)) h1
          refine ⟨m, ?_, anc_right v l r m p hmp, anc_right v l r m q hmq, ?_⟩
          · rw [aux_node_eq]; simp [hA, hm]
          · intro x dx dm hxp hxq hdx hdm
            by_cases hxv : v = x
            · rw [← hxv] at hdx
              rw [depth_self] at hdx
              simp at hdx
              omega
            · rw [is_ancestor, if_neg hxv] at hxp hxq
              have hxpr : is_ancestor r x p := by
                rcases hxp with h | h
                · exact absurd (anc_contains_tgt l x p h) hlp
                · exact h
              have hxqr : is_ancestor r x q := by
                rcases hxq with h | h
                · exact absurd (anc_contains_tgt l x q h) hlq
                · exact h
              have hxcr : tree_contains r x = true := anc_contains_anc r x p hxpr
              have hmcr : tree_contains r m = true := anc_contains_anc r m p hmp
              obtain ⟨d', hd'⟩ := depth_some_of r x hxcr
              obtain ⟨e', he'⟩ := depth_some_of r m hmcr
              have hxl : get_depth l x = none :=
                depth_none_of l x (fun h => disj_contra hlr h hxcr)
              have hml : get_depth l m = none :=
                depth_none_of l m (fun h => disj_contra hlr h hmcr)
              have hmv : ¬ v = m := by
                intro hc
                subst hc
                exact hvr ((contains_iff_view r v).mp hmcr)
              rw [depth_node_right v l r x d' hxv hxl hd'] at hdx
              rw [depth_node_right v l r m e' hmv hml he'] at hdm
              simp at hdx hdm
              have := hopt x d' e' hxpr hxqr hd' he'
              omega
        · have hA : (aux l p q).1 = none := by
            cases hg : (aux l p q).1 with
            | none => rfl
            | some m' => exact absurd (aux_some p q l (by rw [hg]; rfl)) h1
          have hB : (aux r p q).1 = none := by
            cases hg : (aux r p q).1 with
            | none => rfl
            | some m' => exact absurd (aux_some p q r (by rw [hg]; rfl)) h2
          have hP : ((v == p) || (aux l p q).2.1 || (aux r p q).2.1) = true := by
            rw [aux_hasP, aux_hasP]
            rw [tree_contains] at hp
            exact hp
          have hQ : ((v == q) || (aux l p q).2.2 || (aux r p q).2.2) = true := by
            rw [aux_hasQ, aux_hasQ]
            rw [tree_contains] at hq
            exact hq
          refine ⟨v, ?_, anc_self v l r p hp, anc_self v l r q hq, ?_⟩
          · rw [aux_node_eq]; simp [hA, hB, hP, hQ]
          · intro x dx dm hxp hxq hdx hdm
            rw [depth_self] at hdm
            simp at hdm
            by_cases hxv : v = x
            · rw [← hxv] at hdx
              rw [depth_self] at hdx
              simp at hdx
              omega
            · exfalso
              rw [is_ancestor, if_neg hxv] at hxp hxq
              rcases hxp with hp1 | hp1 <;> rcases hxq with hq1 | hq1
              · exact h1 ⟨anc_contains_tgt l x p hp1, anc_contains_tgt l x q hq1⟩
              · exact disj_contra hlr (anc_contains_anc l x p hp1)
                  (anc_contains_anc r x q hq1)
              · exact disj_contra hlr (anc_contains_anc l x q hq1)
                  (anc_contains_anc r x p hp1)
              · exact h2 ⟨anc_contains_tgt r x p hp1, anc_contains_tgt r x q hq1⟩

-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem lowest_common_ancestor_postcond_satisfied (root : Node) (p q : Nat)
    (h_precond : lowest_common_ancestor_precond root p q) :
    lowest_common_ancestor_postcond root p q (lowest_common_ancestor root p q h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  obtain ⟨hp, hq, hdist⟩ := h_precond
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmp, hmq, hopt⟩ := aux_main p q root hdist hp hq
  simp only [lowest_common_ancestor_postcond, lowest_common_ancestor, hm]
  refine ⟨hmp, hmq, ?_⟩
  intro x hxp hxq
  cases hdx : get_depth root x with
  | none => simp
  | some dx =>
      cases hdm : get_depth root m with
      | none => simp
      | some dm => exact hopt x dx dm hxp hxq hdx hdm
  -- !benchmark @end proof

**LEAN VERIFIED** — the check passes (only two warnings: an unused `h_precond` binder and a deprecated Mathlib name).

## What I did

**`code`:** `(aux root p q).1` — the teacher-provided single post-order traversal LCA. No alternate algorithm, sorting, `Nat.find`, `Classical.choose`, or decision procedure.

**`lemma`:** a genuine supporting theory, all proved:
- `contains_iff_view`, `disj_contra` — bridge `tree_contains` to `view`, and use `view l ∩ view r = ∅` from `tree_distinct` to rule out a value living in both subtrees.
- `anc_contains_anc` / `anc_contains_tgt` / `anc_left` / `anc_right` / `anc_self` — structural facts about `is_ancestor`.
- `depth_isSome`, `depth_none_of`, `depth_some_of`, `depth_self`, `depth_node_left`, `depth_node_right` — `get_depth` exists exactly when the node exists, and depth increases by 1 descending into the correct subtree.
- `aux_node_eq` (unfolds the destructuring `let`s into projections), `aux_hasP`, `aux_hasQ` (the flags equal `tree_contains`), `aux_some` (`aux` returns `some` only if both targets are present).
- `aux_main` — the core induction: under `tree_distinct`, if both `p` and `q` are in `t`, then `(aux t p q).1 = some m` with `m` a common ancestor and `dx ≤ dm` for every common ancestor `x`. Three cases: both targets in the left subtree (result is the left LCA), both in the right, or otherwise the split/self case where `v` is the *only* common ancestor (depth 0), the other three placements being contradictory by distinctness.

**`proof`:** instantiates `aux_main` at the root and discharges the postcondition's `match` on the two depths.

## Semantic audit
- All three precondition components (`tree_contains root p`, `tree_contains root q`, `tree_distinct root`) are consumed; distinctness is essential for the optimality argument, containment for existence of a result.
- The postcondition is proved exactly as stated, including the `none => False` branch (the result is always `some`) and the universally quantified deepest-ancestor clause — nothing weakened.
- Edge cases: `nil` root is impossible under the precondition and handled in the induction base; `p = q`, `p` an ancestor of `q`, and a single-node tree all fall out of the split/self case. Values are `Nat`, so no negative-value case exists.
- No `sorry`/`admit`/axioms/`partial`/`unsafe` in the editable regions; all four marker pairs are intact and `auxcode` was left empty.
